ns2:section.sectionText: This course is an introduction into the role of accounting information in establishing organizational objectives and goals. It introduces students to strategies for achieving such objectives and goals, and into methods for the testing of such strategies. Topics focus on the utility of information necessary for the formation, execution and monitoring of the variety of contracts embedded in organization strategies. Projects facilitate self-discovery of knowledge and development of a variety of professional skills and attitudes. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen in the Unit One Living-Learning Community or by permission of instructor or Unit One academic director. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course. Students who enroll in more than one Discovery course may be dropped from the additional Discovery Courses. For course descriptions, see the Discovery Program booklet.
